So since its really late, I’m tired, pissed off I’m not gonna do the details of the games because like i said, i already typed out a quality tr, it just got screwed, so if u wanna be a prick gimme one star, if not just enjoy a semi cool tr.

Oh, and if the caps and grammar suck well, you try typing perfect after you just spent 3 hours for nothing.

my podrace sucked bad, i drew 4 1’s and a 0. and i have like 30 cards that are highr then 4 in my deck. so i lost race and got a FL by something.

He played some ties w/ pilots thing, i beat on a lone tie interceptor for like 20, i won by 30 something.

We set up semi slow, the game almost timed out due to heavy retrievel on my part and heavy damage on his. i retrieved over 40 force that game. cool huh? he won by 8. I killed maul 5 times or something with invinco Luke with resilience.

I win bye 41.

Game 6, vs some guy i know but i dont know his name. all that happened really was i crassed luke and beatdown obi and that pretty much won the game along with my podrace.
